text: 高射炮打蚊子——大材小用
pinyin: gāo shè pào dǎ wén zi —— dà cái xiǎo yòng
literal: anti-aircraft gun · shoot · mosquito — big · talent · small · use
natural: firing an anti-aircraft gun at a mosquito

meaning.en: Using a heavy gun against a mosquito; wasting great talent or resources on a trivial job.
meaning.zh: 用高射炮打蚊子；比喻有大本事却用在小事上，浪费人才或资源。

equivalents: use a sledgehammer to crack a nut

examples.zh: 让博士生去录入数据，简直是高射炮打蚊子。
examples.en: Making a PhD student do data entry is using a sledgehammer to crack a nut.

examples.zh: 这么小的活儿用你，高射炮打蚊子了。
examples.en: You're far too good for such a small job.

usage.en: Usually only the first half is said, leaving the listener to supply the punchline. Casual and humorous.
usage.zh: 多只说前半句，后半句由听者自己领会。口语，带诙谐意味。

text: 门缝里看人——把人看扁了
pinyin: mén fèng lǐ kàn rén —— bǎ rén kàn biǎn le
variants: 门缝里瞧人——把人看扁了
从门缝里看人——把人看扁了
literal: door · crack · in · look at · person — make · person · look · flat · -ed
natural: peeping at people through a door crack

meaning.en: Looking at someone through a crack in the door makes them look flat; underestimating or looking down on a person.
meaning.zh: 从门缝里看人，人是扁的；比喻轻视别人。

examples.zh: 你别门缝里看人，他其实很有能力。
examples.en: Don't underestimate him; he's actually very capable.

examples.zh: 她被人用门缝里看人的眼光对待，心里很不是滋味。
examples.en: She was treated as if looked down upon through a crack in the door, and it didn't feel good.

usage.en: Usually only the first half is said, leaving the listener to supply the punchline. Casual and humorous. The pun is on 扁 ('flat'), which also means 'belittled'.
usage.zh: 多只说前半句，后半句由听者自己领会。口语，带诙谐意味。“扁”既指扁平，也指被小看。

text: 鞋底抹油——溜了
pinyin: xié dǐ mǒ yóu —— liū le
literal: shoe · sole · smear · oil — slip away · -ed
natural: oil on the soles of one's shoes

meaning.en: With oil on the soles one slips away easily; sneaking off or making a quick escape.
meaning.zh: 鞋底抹了油，一溜就走；比喻偷偷溜走，溜之大吉。

examples.zh: 一看要开会，他就鞋底抹油，溜了。
examples.en: The moment a meeting was announced, he slipped off.

examples.zh: 警察来了，那帮人早就鞋底抹油了。
examples.en: By the time the police came the gang had already scarpered.

usage.en: Usually only the first half is said, leaving the listener to supply the punchline. Casual and humorous. 溜 means both 'slide' and 'sneak away'.
usage.zh: 多只说前半句，后半句由听者自己领会。口语，带诙谐意味。“溜”既指滑行，也指悄悄走开。

text: 豆腐掉进灰堆里——吹不得打不得
pinyin: dòu fu diào jìn huī duī lǐ —— chuī bù de dǎ bù de
literal: tofu · fall into · ash · heap · inside — blow · cannot · hit · cannot
natural: tofu dropped in the ashes

meaning.en: Tofu in the ashes can neither be blown clean nor beaten clean; a delicate situation where nothing can be done.
meaning.zh: 豆腐掉进灰堆，吹也不行，拍也不行；比喻处境尴尬，怎么处理都不好。

equivalents: between a rock and a hard place
a delicate situation with no good way out

examples.zh: 他是老板的亲戚，批评也不是，不批评也不是，豆腐掉进灰堆里。
examples.en: He's the boss's relative; criticising or not criticising are both awkward.

examples.zh: 这件事真是豆腐掉进灰堆里，没法收拾。
examples.en: This matter is a real dilemma and can't be handled.

usage.en: Usually only the first half is said, leaving the listener to supply the punchline. Casual and humorous. Sometimes used of a person too sensitive to be criticised.
usage.zh: 多只说前半句，后半句由听者自己领会。口语，带诙谐意味。有时也指不能批评、不能碰的人。

text: 乌鸦站在猪身上——光看见别人黑
pinyin: wū yā zhàn zài zhū shēn shàng —— guāng kàn jiàn bié rén hēi
variants: 乌鸦笑猪黑——光看别人黑，不见自己黑
literal: crow · stand · on · pig · body · on — only · see · others · black
natural: a crow on a pig sees only the pig's blackness

meaning.en: A black crow perched on a black pig sees only the pig's black; people who see others' faults but not their own.
meaning.zh: 黑乌鸦站在黑猪身上，只看见猪黑；比喻只看到别人的缺点，看不到自己的。

equivalents: the pot calling the kettle black
see the mote in another's eye

examples.zh: 你说他自私，自己呢？乌鸦站在猪身上，光看见别人黑。
examples.en: You call him selfish, but what about you? It's the pot calling the kettle black.

examples.zh: 乌鸦站在猪身上，批评别人前先照照镜子。
examples.en: Look in the mirror before criticising others.

usage.en: Usually only the first half is said, leaving the listener to supply the punchline. Casual and humorous.
usage.zh: 多只说前半句，后半句由听者自己领会。口语，带诙谐意味。

text: 拔了毛的凤凰——不如鸡
pinyin: bá le máo de fèng huáng —— bù rú jī
literal: pluck · -ed · feathers · 's · phoenix — not · as good as · chicken
natural: a plucked phoenix is worse than a chicken

meaning.en: A phoenix stripped of its feathers is no better than a chicken; a once-eminent person who has fallen on hard times.
meaning.zh: 凤凰拔光了毛，还不如鸡；比喻有地位的人一旦失势，处境反而不如普通人。

examples.zh: 他下台以后，拔了毛的凤凰，门前冷落。
examples.en: Since leaving office he's a fallen idol and nobody calls.

examples.zh: 别笑话他，拔了毛的凤凰也曾辉煌过。
examples.en: Don't mock him; he had his glory days.

usage.en: Usually only the first half is said, leaving the listener to supply the punchline. Casual and humorous. Often quoted in the saying 落水的凤凰不如鸡.
usage.zh: 多只说前半句，后半句由听者自己领会。口语，带诙谐意味。常引作俗话“落水的凤凰不如鸡”。

text: 懒婆娘的裹脚布——又臭又长
pinyin: lǎn pó niáng de guǒ jiǎo bù —— yòu chòu yòu cháng
variants: 老太太的裹脚布——又臭又长
literal: lazy · woman · 's · foot-binding · cloth — also · smelly · also · long
natural: a lazy woman's foot bindings: smelly and long

meaning.en: The foot-bindings of a slovenly woman are both smelly and long; a speech or article that is dull and far too long.
meaning.zh: 懒婆娘的裹脚布又臭又长；比喻文章或讲话冗长乏味。

examples.zh: 他的报告像懒婆娘的裹脚布，又臭又长。
examples.en: His report is dull and endless.

examples.zh: 会上那篇发言，懒婆娘的裹脚布一样，听得人直打瞌睡。
examples.en: That speech dragged on until I nodded off.

usage.en: Usually only the first half is said, leaving the listener to supply the punchline. Casual and humorous. The image refers to the old custom of foot-binding; a dated, rather unflattering expression.
usage.zh: 多只说前半句，后半句由听者自己领会。口语，带诙谐意味。此喻指旧时缠足的风俗；较陈旧，略带贬损。

text: 飞机上吹喇叭——响（想）得高
pinyin: fēi jī shàng chuī lǎ ba —— xiǎng (xiǎng) dé gāo
literal: aeroplane · on · blow · trumpet — resound (think) · -ly · high
natural: blowing a trumpet on an aeroplane: sounds high

meaning.en: A pun: a trumpet blown on a plane 'sounds high' (响得高); also read as 'thinks high' (想得高), being overambitious.
meaning.zh: 双关：飞机上吹喇叭，声音响得高；谐“想得高”，比喻想得太好、不切实际。

equivalents: have one's head in the clouds

examples.zh: 他想三个月赚一百万，真是飞机上吹喇叭。
examples.en: He wants to make a million in three months; his ambition is sky-high.

examples.zh: 飞机上吹喇叭，你的想法太高了。
examples.en: Your thinking is far too lofty.

usage.en: Usually only the first half is said, leaving the listener to supply the punchline. Casual and humorous. A pun: 响 (xiǎng, loud) sounds like 想 (xiǎng, think), so 响得高 hints at 想得高, 'thinking too high'.
usage.zh: 多只说前半句，后半句由听者自己领会。口语，带诙谐意味。谐音双关：“响”与“想”同音，“响得高”暗指“想得高”。

text: 打破砂锅——问（纹）到底
pinyin: dǎ pò shā guō —— wèn (wèn) dào dǐ
literal: smash · earthenware pot — ask (crack) · to · the bottom
natural: smash the clay pot and the crack runs to the bottom

meaning.en: A cracked clay pot's fracture runs to the bottom; a pun on 璺 (wèn, crack) and 问 (wèn, ask), meaning to question something thoroughly.
meaning.zh: 砂锅一裂，裂璺直到锅底；“璺”谐“问”，比喻追根究底。

equivalents: get to the bottom of something

examples.zh: 他这个人打破砂锅，什么事都要问到底。
examples.en: He's the type who must get to the bottom of everything.

examples.zh: 你这是打破砂锅问到底，何必呢？
examples.en: You're digging into every detail; why bother?

usage.en: Usually only the first half is said, leaving the listener to supply the punchline. Casual and humorous. A pun: 纹 (wén, crack) sounds like 问 (wèn, ask); 砂锅 is also written 沙锅.
usage.zh: 多只说前半句，后半句由听者自己领会。口语，带诙谐意味。谐音双关：“纹”与“问”音近；“砂锅”也写作“沙锅”。

text: 搬起石头砸自己的脚——自作自受
pinyin: bān qǐ shí tou zá zì jǐ de jiǎo —— zì zuò zì shòu
literal: lift · up · stone · smash · one's own · 's · foot — self · do · self · suffer
natural: lifting a rock and dropping it on one's own foot

meaning.en: Picking up a rock to throw and dropping it on one's own foot; a scheme that backfires on the one who made it.
meaning.zh: 搬起石头想砸别人，结果砸了自己的脚；比喻害人不成反害己。

examples.zh: 他造谣诽谤别人，结果搬起石头砸自己的脚。
examples.en: He slandered others and it backfired on him.

examples.zh: 这样做无异于搬起石头砸自己的脚。
examples.en: Doing it this way is shooting yourself in the foot.

usage.en: Usually only the first half is said, leaving the listener to supply the punchline. Casual and humorous. The first half is often quoted alone, e.g. as a warning.
usage.zh: 多只说前半句，后半句由听者自己领会。口语，带诙谐意味。前半句常单独引用作警告。

text: 水中捞月——一场空
pinyin: shuǐ zhōng lāo yuè —— yī chǎng kōng
literal: water · in · fish out · moon — one · scene · empty
natural: scooping the moon out of the water

meaning.en: Trying to scoop the moon's reflection out of the water; efforts that are bound to end in nothing.
meaning.zh: 想捞起水里的月亮；比喻白费力气，终究落空。

examples.zh: 没有基础就想创业，无异于水中捞月。
examples.en: Starting a business without any foundation is chasing a mirage.

examples.zh: 折腾半天，最后水中捞月，一场空。
examples.en: After all that fuss it came to nothing.

usage.en: Usually only the first half is said, leaving the listener to supply the punchline. Casual and humorous. The four-character form 水中捞月 is also a chengyu.
usage.zh: 多只说前半句，后半句由听者自己领会。口语，带诙谐意味。四字形式“水中捞月”本身也是成语。

story.en: In the Mahasamghika Vinaya, a band of monkeys sees the moon's reflection in a well and tries to rescue it, only to fall and drown. The story is the source of the 'fishing the moon from the water' image.
story.zh: 《摩诃僧祇律》卷七载猕猴见井中月影，欲捞取之，结果坠井而死，是“水中捞月”之典所本。

text: 瞎子吃汤圆——心中有数
pinyin: xiā zi chī tāng yuán —— xīn zhōng yǒu shù
literal: blind person · eat · rice dumpling — heart · in · have · number
natural: a blind man eating tangyuan

meaning.en: A blind person eating glutinous rice balls knows how many he has eaten; having a clear idea in one's own mind without saying so.
meaning.zh: 瞎子吃汤圆，吃了几个自己清楚；比喻心里有数，不必明说。

examples.zh: 你放心，这事我瞎子吃汤圆，心中有数。
examples.en: Don't worry, I know exactly where I stand.

examples.zh: 他嘴上不说，其实瞎子吃汤圆，什么都清楚。
examples.en: He says nothing but knows full well.

usage.en: Usually only the first half is said, leaving the listener to supply the punchline. Casual and humorous. The wording 瞎子 can sound impolite; often replaced by 哑巴吃饺子.
usage.zh: 多只说前半句，后半句由听者自己领会。口语，带诙谐意味。“瞎子”一词略显不敬，常换成“哑巴吃饺子”。

text: 当一天和尚撞一天钟——得过且过
pinyin: dāng yī tiān hé shang zhuàng yī tiān zhōng —— dé guò qiě guò
variants: 做一天和尚撞一天钟——得过且过
literal: be · one · day · monk · strike · one · day · bell — get · by · for now · get · by
natural: be a monk for a day, ring the bell for a day

meaning.en: Being a monk for a day means ringing the bell for a day; going through the motions without effort or ambition.
meaning.zh: 当一天和尚，就撞一天钟；比喻做事敷衍，没有长远打算。

examples.zh: 他对工作当一天和尚撞一天钟，毫无进取心。
examples.en: He just goes through the motions at work, with no ambition.

examples.zh: 你别当一天和尚撞一天钟，得想想将来。
examples.en: Don't just drift; think about the future.

usage.en: Usually only the first half is said, leaving the listener to supply the punchline. Casual and humorous.
usage.zh: 多只说前半句，后半句由听者自己领会。口语，带诙谐意味。

text: 屎壳郎戴花——臭美
pinyin: shǐ ké láng dài huā —— chòu měi
literal: dung beetle · wear · flower — smelly · pretty
natural: a dung beetle wearing a flower

meaning.en: A dung beetle with a flower in its hair; someone vain who thinks they look fine when they don't.
meaning.zh: 屎壳郎头上戴花，自以为美；比喻自我感觉良好，爱显摆。

examples.zh: 她穿成这样还照镜子，真是屎壳郎戴花。
examples.en: She looks in the mirror dressed like that; how vain.

examples.zh: 别屎壳郎戴花了，谁看你啊。
examples.en: Stop preening; nobody's looking at you.

usage.en: Usually only the first half is said, leaving the listener to supply the punchline. Casual and humorous. 臭美 is a colloquial word for 'vain'; a mildly teasing remark among friends.
usage.zh: 多只说前半句，后半句由听者自己领会。口语，带诙谐意味。“臭美”口语，意为自我欣赏；朋友间半开玩笑用。

text: 四两棉花——谈（弹）不上
pinyin: sì liǎng mián hua —— tán (tán) bù shàng
literal: four · liang · cotton — talk (fluff) · cannot · up
natural: four liang of cotton can't be fluffed

meaning.en: A pun: four liang of cotton is too little to fluff (弹); 谈 'talk' means it's not worth discussing.
meaning.zh: 双关：四两棉花太少，弹不成；“弹”谐“谈”，意为不值一谈。

examples.zh: 这点成绩四两棉花，谈不上什么功劳。
examples.en: These modest results are nothing to speak of.

examples.zh: 你这点本事，四两棉花，谈不上专业。
examples.en: With your skill, it hardly qualifies as professional.

usage.en: Usually only the first half is said, leaving the listener to supply the punchline. Casual and humorous. A pun: 弹 (tán, fluff cotton) sounds like 谈 (tán, talk).
usage.zh: 多只说前半句，后半句由听者自己领会。口语，带诙谐意味。谐音双关：“弹”与“谈”同音。

text: 黄鼠狼单咬病鸭子——专拣弱的欺
pinyin: huáng shǔ láng dān yǎo bìng yā zi —— zhuān jiǎn ruò de qī
literal: weasel · only · bite · sick · duck — specially · pick · weak · ones · bully
natural: the weasel bites only the sick duck

meaning.en: A weasel only attacks the sick duck; a bully who preys on the weak.
meaning.zh: 黄鼠狼专咬有病的鸭子；比喻欺负弱者。

equivalents: pick on those who can't fight back

examples.zh: 这些骗子黄鼠狼单咬病鸭子，专骗老人。
examples.en: These swindlers prey on the weak, targeting the elderly.

examples.zh: 黄鼠狼单咬病鸭子，他专找新人的麻烦。
examples.en: He picks on newcomers.

usage.en: Usually only the first half is said, leaving the listener to supply the punchline. Casual and humorous. Close in meaning to the earlier 老太太吃柿子——专挑软的捏.
usage.zh: 多只说前半句，后半句由听者自己领会。口语，带诙谐意味。意思与“老太太吃柿子——专挑软的捏”相近。

text: 狗改不了吃屎——本性难移
pinyin: gǒu gǎi bù liǎo chī shǐ —— běn xìng nán yí
literal: dog · change · cannot · eat · dung — original · nature · hard · change
natural: a dog can't give up eating dung

meaning.en: A dog won't give up eating dung; a person's bad habits are hard to change.
meaning.zh: 狗改不掉吃屎的习惯；比喻坏习惯、本性难以改变。

equivalents: a leopard can't change its spots

examples.zh: 他又赌钱了，真是狗改不了吃屎。
examples.en: He's gambling again; a leopard can't change its spots.

examples.zh: 说了多少次也没用，狗改不了吃屎。
examples.en: I've told him often enough; it's no use.

usage.en: Usually only the first half is said, leaving the listener to supply the punchline. Casual and humorous. Vulgar and rude when applied to a person; the second half 本性难移 is itself a common proverb.
usage.zh: 多只说前半句，后半句由听者自己领会。口语，带诙谐意味。用于人时粗俗，不礼貌；后半句“本性难移”本身也是常用成语。

text: 猪鼻子插大葱——装象（相）
pinyin: zhū bí zi chā dà cōng —— zhuāng xiàng (xiàng)
literal: pig · nose · stick in · big · scallion — pose as · elephant (appearance)
natural: a pig with a spring onion in its snout, posing as an elephant

meaning.en: A pig with a spring onion stuck in its nose looks like an elephant; a pun on 象 (elephant) and 相 (pose), for pretending to be something one is not.
meaning.zh: 猪鼻子插上大葱像大象；“象”谐“相”，比喻装模作样，冒充内行。

equivalents: pretend to be what one isn't

examples.zh: 他不懂装懂，就像猪鼻子插大葱。
examples.en: He pretends to know what he doesn't, like a pig in elephant's clothing.

examples.zh: 别猪鼻子插大葱了，露馅了。
examples.en: Stop putting on airs; you've given yourself away.

usage.en: Usually only the first half is said, leaving the listener to supply the punchline. Casual and humorous. A pun: 象 (xiàng, elephant) and 相 (xiàng, 装相 'put on a show'); the punchline is often written either way.
usage.zh: 多只说前半句，后半句由听者自己领会。口语，带诙谐意味。谐音双关：“象”与“相”同音，“装相”即装模作样；后半句两种写法都常见。

text: 和尚打伞——无法（发）无天
pinyin: hé shang dǎ sǎn —— wú fǎ (fà) wú tiān
variants: 癞痢头撑伞——无法（发）无天
literal: monk · hold · umbrella — no · law (hair) · no · sky
natural: a monk with an umbrella: no hair, no sky

meaning.en: A bald monk under an umbrella has no hair (发) and no sky overhead; a pun on 法 (law), for someone who acts lawlessly and without restraint.
meaning.zh: 和尚打伞，头上无发，也看不到天；“发”谐“法”，比喻肆无忌惮，什么规矩都不顾。

examples.zh: 这孩子被宠坏了，和尚打伞，无法无天。
examples.en: The kid has been spoiled and does as he pleases.

examples.zh: 他在公司和尚打伞，没人管得了。
examples.en: He answers to no one in the company.

usage.en: Usually only the first half is said, leaving the listener to supply the punchline. Casual and humorous. A pun: 发 (fà, hair) sounds like 法 (fǎ, law); 无法无天 is also a chengyu.
usage.zh: 多只说前半句，后半句由听者自己领会。口语，带诙谐意味。谐音双关：“发”与“法”音近；“无法无天”本身也是成语。

text: 猪八戒摔耙子——不干了
pinyin: zhū bā jiè shuāi pá zi —— bù gàn le
literal: Zhu Bajie · fling down · rake — not · do · -ed
natural: Pigsy flings down his rake

meaning.en: Pigsy throws down his rake and quits; giving up in a huff.
meaning.zh: 猪八戒把耙子一摔，不干了；比喻撂挑子，不肯再做。

examples.zh: 一受批评就猪八戒摔耙子，怎么行？
examples.en: Quitting in a huff at the first criticism won't do.

examples.zh: 要是这样安排，我就猪八戒摔耙子了。
examples.en: If you arrange it like that, I'm walking out.

usage.en: Usually only the first half is said, leaving the listener to supply the punchline. Casual and humorous. Pigsy's rake (钉耙) is his weapon in 《西游记》; he often threatens to abandon the pilgrimage.
usage.zh: 多只说前半句，后半句由听者自己领会。口语，带诙谐意味。钉耙是猪八戒在《西游记》中的兵器，他常闹着不去西天了。

text: 茅坑里的石头——又臭又硬
pinyin: máo kēng lǐ de shí tou —— yòu chòu yòu yìng
variants: 屎坑里的砖头——又臭又硬
粪缸里泡过的石头——又臭又硬
literal: latrine · pit · in · 's · stone — also · smelly · also · hard
natural: a stone in the latrine: smelly and hard

meaning.en: A stone in a toilet pit is both foul and hard; a stubborn person with an unpleasant manner.
meaning.zh: 茅坑里的石头又臭又硬；比喻人固执又讨厌。

examples.zh: 他是茅坑里的石头，又臭又硬，谁劝也不听。
examples.en: He's obstinate and nasty; nobody can persuade him.

examples.zh: 这个老头儿像茅坑里的石头，脾气又臭又硬。
examples.en: That old man is stubborn and foul-tempered.

usage.en: Usually only the first half is said, leaving the listener to supply the punchline. Casual and humorous. Vulgar; used for an obstinate person or a stubborn, unpleasant style.
usage.zh: 多只说前半句，后半句由听者自己领会。口语，带诙谐意味。较粗俗，指人固执且令人讨厌。
